nodes.description: Public token name string set in constructor.
Public token symbol string set in constructor.
Public uint8 decimals, set to 18 in constructor.
Total token supply; written in constructor, read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance store; written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor: mints the whole supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Reads balances[tokenOwner].
Reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] unconditionally and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowance of msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd.
Checked addition with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication; unused by CaliCoin.
Checked division; unused by CaliCoin.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance key in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Unconditional allowance overwrite in approve allows the classic approve/transferFrom race.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking for the uint(-1) infinite-approval convention.
Unchecked _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] subtraction in totalSupply() (Solidity 0.5 without SafeMath).
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf/allowance used as mapping lookup key.
Parameter spender of approve, used as second key of allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Parameter tokens of approve, written into the allowance slot.
Parameter to of transfer, credited via safeAdd.
Parameter tokens of transfer, debited via safeSub.
Parameter from of transferFrom, debited via safeSub.
Parameter to of transferFrom, credited via safeAdd.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, used for both balance and allowance subtraction.

edges.reason: Constructor keys the initial mint on msg.sender.
msg.sender chooses the balances mapping slot written in constructor/transfer.
approve derives the allowance owner from msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] for the caller-supplied amount.
transferFrom spends the allowance owned by msg.sender.
Caller identity governs the allowance slot that approve overwrites without restriction.
msg.sender allowance is arbitrarily reduced inside transferFrom.
spender parameter is the write key for the overwritten allowance entry.
tokens parameter is the value written into the allowance entry.
approve mutates the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
transfer delegates the sender debit to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates both subtractions to SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the credit to SafeMath.safeAdd.
balances values are arguments to the checked subtraction.
balances values are arguments to the checked addition.
Constructor assigns the initial value of _totalSupply.
Constructor writes the full supply into balances.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend and can exceed _totalSupply, underflowing.
totalSupply() executes the unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
transfer recipient 'to' is the credit key passed to safeAdd.
transfer 'tokens' is the debit amount passed to safeSub.
transferFrom 'from' is the balance key debited through safeSub.
transferFrom recipient 'to' is credited through safeAdd.
transferFrom 'tokens' is subtracted from both balance and allowance via safeSub.
tokenOwner parameter selects the allowance entry returned.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is only a lookup key consumed inside allowance(), so it should be folded into that core function node.
spender directly identifies the allowance slot overwritten by the unsafe approve operation.
tokens is the exact value written by the unconditional allowance overwrite.
to is the credit key handed straight to safeAdd inside transfer().
tokens is the debit amount handed straight to safeSub inside transfer().
from is the balance key directly debited through safeSub in transferFrom().
to is the recipient credited directly through safeAdd in transferFrom().
tokens is subtracted from balance and allowance through safeSub in transferFrom().
